newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower as banks post losses.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower as banks post losses.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed lower on Tuesday but off the day's low, lifted a little towards the close of trade when Wall Street opened with gains.
The Stockholm general index slipped 0.24 percent to 2213.07 on fair turnover of 3.8 billion crowns.
The bluechip stocks were mixed. Telecoms giant Ericsson closed unchanged at 200 crowns while drugs major Astra rose three to 310 crowns.
But the banking sector dragged the market down, with the sector's index falling 1.55 percent, reversing some of Monday's gains amid speculation of a sector reshuffle.
S-E-Banken slipped 0.5 to 62 crowns while Handelsbanken fell 6.5 to 175 crowns. Nordbanken fell four to 199 crowns.
Airline SAS posted a fall in nine month pre-tax profits to 1.26 billion crowns versus 2.1 billion a year earlier. Its shares closed two lower at 82 crowns.
